method: Batch 48 (pistonpush): the batch 47 serverplayer harness (the probe player is the server copy under the C03 rules, row element 8 its position after the tick) with real moving piston blocks: op piston turns a cell into BlockPistonMoving with a real TileEntityPiston that the probe updates after the mobs each tick (World.updateEntities tile pass), pushing every entity in its box with Entity.moveEntity; row element 9 lists the moving tiles [x, y, z, progress, lastProgress]. Scenarios: a cow, pig, zombie, horse, calf and pairs pushed east, north, up and down, into a wall and a ceiling, by a retracting block, by a piston head and by two tiles; and the server copy pushed with the client staying, following, against a wall, after a knockback, at a ledge (sneaking and not), lifted, flying, by a retract and with a herd. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
